title: Venezuelan Spring Rolls
description: A delicious and crispy Venezuelan-inspired spring roll dish filled with warm, smoky flavors.

ingredients.name: Spring vegetable mix (carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)

instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together the spring vegetable mix, smoked cheese, Venezuelan spices, and olive oil.
3. Place a warm flour tortilla on a flat surface.
4. Brush the edges of the tortilla with the beaten egg.
5. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the vegetable mixture onto the center of the tortilla.
6. Roll the tortilla into a tight cylinder and place seam-side down on a baking sheet.
7. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
8. Bake the spring rolls in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
